ignoreCommand: case "${VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF:-}" in main|preview/hook-generator/*|deploy/hook-generator/*|preview/all/*|deploy/all/*) exit 1 ;; esac; [ -n "${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-}" ] && [ -n "${VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA:-}" ] || exit 0; git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" -- :/hook-generator :/packages/shared; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 1 ] && exit 1; exit 0
